sections.Intro: The most effective use of Agnus is in cases of sexual debility and loss of sexual power. It is indicated in both sexes for these conditions. There is a general lack of vital force, with coldness of the body. Premature old age.
sections.Mind: Absent-minded. Forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Fears death.
sections.Head: Dull headache, especially in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach.
sections.Male: Sexual debility. Coldness of the genitals. Yellow discharge from the urethra.
sections.Female: Leucorrhoea, with a sensation of coldness. Loss of sexual desire.
sections.Skin: Itching and burning. Yellow spots on the skin.
